paper.title: Interferometric Single-Shot Parity Measurement in InAs-Al Hybrid Devices

result.summary: 本文在 InAs-Al 异质结中实现了对纳米线与量子点构成的干涉环中费米宇称的单次干涉测量 [abstract][S1.p3]。作者通过色散栅极传感测量量子点量子电容，观察到 h/2e 周期的双模分布和随机电报信号，并提取出约 2 ms 的驻留时间 [S3.p3]。这些结果与一对相距约 3 µm 的 Majorana 零能模的费米宇称测量一致，且准粒子中毒率较低 [abstract][S3.p9]。作者指出该测量本身不能唯一区分拓扑相中的 MZMs 与精细调节的平庸 Andreev 束缚态，但为基于测量操作的拓扑量子比特提供了关键进展 [S1.p3][S5.p2]。

research_question.text: 论文旨在实现拓扑量子计算中测量非阿贝尔任意子融合所需的基本操作，即确定一对 Majorana 零能模共享的费米宇称 [abstract][S1.p1]。作者指出，在拓扑超导体中，这一操作对应于确定 Majorana 零能模的共享费米宇称，而测量型拓扑量子计算将操作简化为融合测量 [abstract][S1.p1]。该测量是拓扑量子比特状态读出和量子信息处理的关键步骤 [S1.p2]。

evidence.quote: The fusion of non-Abelian anyons or topological defects is a fundamental operation in measurement-only topological quantum computation.
In topological superconductors, this operation amounts to a determination of the shared fermion parity of Majorana zero modes.
Protocols for measurement-only topological quantum computation simplify these operations, reducing them to fusion alone.

Quantum information is stored in the fermion parity of Majorana zero modes (MZMs) localized at the ends of superconducting wires, and projective measurements of the fermion parity are used to process quantum information and perform qubit state readout.

method.text: 作者设计了一个由门定义的纳米线和三量子点干涉仪组成的器件，其中纳米线段可调至一维拓扑超导态，量子点对耦合在干涉环中 [S2.p1]。测量基于色散栅极传感探测量子点 2 的量子电容，通过片外谐振电路和约瑟夫森行波参量放大器进行反射测量 [S2.p3]。作者还建立了包含 MZM、量子点和环境耦合的有效模型，并用 Lindblad 主方程模拟动态量子电容响应 [S3.p4][S3.p6]。

evidence.quote: The first component is a nanowire, sections of which can be tuned into a 1DTS state, leading to topological degeneracy of the many-body ground state.
The second component consists of quantum dots, which are designed to couple pairs of MZMs in an interferometric loop.

Our readout circuit is based on dispersive gate sensing of a triple quantum dot interferometer (TQDI): three electrostatically defined quantum dots that together with the 1DTS form a loop threaded by a flux, $\Phi$ ( Fig. 1 a,c).
The quantum capacitance, $C_{\mathrm{\scriptscriptstyle Q}}$, of dot 2 is read out through dispersive gate sensing using an off-chip resonator circuit in a reflectometry setup.
We support this interpretation by reproducing our results with quantum dynamics simulations that incorporate rf drive power, charge noise, and temperature.

For detailed comparison with experiments, we simulate a more complete model of our interferometer, expanded to include the full triple-dot system, incoherent coupling to the environment, and backaction from the measurement.

experiments.text: 作者在器件 A 和器件 B 上进行了测量，器件 A 的相关参数区间为面内磁场约 1.8 T 和 $V_{\mathrm{\scriptscriptstyle WP1}}=-1.832\text{\,}\mathrm{V}$ [S3.p2]。测量包括约 1.5×10^4 次连续测量，每次积分时间 4.5 µs，总时长 67 ms，并扫描面外磁场和量子点 2 的栅压 [S3.p1]。作者还进行了对照实验：注入准粒子、断开量子点与纳米线的连接、以及在 0.8 T 的低场下重复测量 [S3.p12][S3.p13][S3.p14]。

evidence.quote: For device A, the relevant regime is in the neighborhood of $B_{\parallel}=$1.8\text{\,}\mathrm{T}$$ and $V_{\mathrm{\scriptscriptstyle WP1}}=$-1.832\text{\,}\mathrm{V}$$.

To measure a time record of the fermion parity, we tune up the TQDI and perform a sequence of nearly $1.5\times 10^{4}$ consecutive measurements of the resonator response, each with an integration time of $4.5\text{\,}\mathrm{\SIUnitSymbolMicro s}$, thereby recording a time trace of total length $67\text{\,}\mathrm{ms}$.

We sweep the out-of-plane magnetic field $B_{\perp}$ in steps of $0.14\text{\,}\mathrm{mT}$ to study the dependence on the external flux $\Phi$ through the interferometer loop and sweep $V_{{\mathrm{\scriptscriptstyle QD}2}}$ to find charge transitions in dot 2.
First, we investigate the impact of injecting quasiparticles into the superconductor as indicated in Fig. 5 a (similar to the approach used in Ref.).
Our second control experiment is to completely disconnect the dots from the wire.

Finally, we repeat the interferometry measurement at a low field ( $0.8\text{\,}\mathrm{T}$), where the device is well within the trivial phase, and the induced gap in the nanowire has not closed yet.

findings.text: 量子电容测量显示 h/2e 周期的双模分布，在最优通量值下信噪比为 1 所需积分时间为 3.7 µs [abstract][S3.p3]。从时间轨迹中提取的两个状态驻留时间在约 2 T 面内磁场下超过 1 ms，与准粒子中毒率低一致 [abstract][S3.p9]。作者将这些 h/2e 周期双模振荡和随机电报信号解释为费米宇称的切换，并通过量子动力学模拟和对照实验支持该解释 [S3.p3][S3.p12][S3.p13]。

evidence.quote: Our quantum capacitance measurements show flux h / 2 ​ e h/2e -periodic bimodality with a signal-to-noise ratio of 1 1 in 3.7 µ ​ s 3.7\text{\,}\mathrm{\SIUnitSymbolMicro s} at optimal flux values.

From the time traces of the quantum capacitance measurements, we extract a dwell time in the two associated states that is longer than 1 ms 1\text{\,}\mathrm{ms} at in-plane magnetic fields of approximately 2 T 2\text{\,}\mathrm{T} .
We interpret these $h/2e$ -periodic bimodal oscillations and RTS in ${\tilde{C}}_{\mathrm{\scriptscriptstyle Q}}$ as originating from switches of fermion parity.
This indicates that quasiparticle injection primarily increases the rate of fermion parity switches, with minimal impact on other TQDI properties.
In devices A and B, we do not observe any RTS, as discussed in Sec. S6.2.

limitations.text: 作者明确指出，该测量本身不能唯一区分拓扑相中的 MZMs 与精细调节的平庸相中的低能 Andreev 束缚态 [S1.p3]。作者还指出，要完全解决低能态是否拓扑的问题，需要在另一篇论文中讨论器件的相图和观测到的通量依赖 RTS 的稳定性 [S5.p1]。此外，作者提到在当前器件中，由于有限尺寸效应，预期 $E_{\mathrm{\scriptscriptstyle M}}$ 会有显著变化，且拓扑能隙和相干长度并非远小于器件长度 [S4.p7]。

evidence.quote: By itself, this measurement does not unequivocally distinguish between MZMs in the topological phase and fine-tuned low-energy Andreev bound states in the trivial phase, but it does require the low-energy state to be supported at both ends of the wire and very weakly coupled to other low-energy states.
To fully resolve this issue, we will discuss the device’s phase diagram and the stability of the observed flux-dependent RTS in a separate publication.

Indeed, in the current generation of devices, we anticipate modest energy gaps $\Delta_{\mathrm{\scriptscriptstyle T}}$ and coherence lengths that are not significantly smaller than the device length.
